{{Quote|Get them for me&hellip;|Janna Relasi's last words|<ref name="GG10" />}}
'''Janna Relasi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked for the [[House Salaktori]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Salaktori assigned her a [[Janna Relasi's ship|starship]] and an [[AD-series weapons maintenance droid]], [[GSAD-43]], to help her in her missions. During those, Relasi and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] bonded intimately.<ref name="GG10" />

In one particular hunt, an [[Janna Relasi's murderer|enemy]] injured Relasi. The huntress managed to reach her ship and talked to GSAD-43. With her dying words, Relasi asked GSAD-43 to "get them for me". The droid took the words at heart and started tracking the people who had killed her. After capturing one of those, the droid, taking a literal meaning to the word "them" in Relasi's sentence, continued to track other culprits.<ref name="GG10" /> In time, GSAD-43 obtained a reputation and Relasi was mentioned in the droid's background.<ref name="CF">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
